name: Hip thrust and glute bridge
pattern: Lying hip extension: shoulders on a bench or the floor, feet planted, the hips drive up until the body is straight from shoulders to knees.
setup: Sit with the bench edge just under your shoulder blades (or lie on the floor for a bridge).
Feet flat, about hip width, placed so the shins are vertical at the top.
Bar or weight over the hip crease, with a pad. Chin tucked, ribs down.

steps.text: Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Stop when shoulders, hips and knees are in a line. Shins vertical.
Hold a second and squeeze your glutes. Pelvis tucked, not arched.
Lower the hips under control until they nearly touch down.

cues.cue: Ribs down, tuck the pelvis at the top.
cues.why: The hips should finish the move; arching the low back fakes the last part of the range.
Feet too close shifts work to the quads; too far shifts it to the hamstrings.

cues.cue: Chin tucked, eyes forward over your knees.
cues.why: The trunk moves as one block with the hips and the neck stays relaxed.

cues.cue: Full hip extension and a short squeeze each rep.
cues.why: Glute activity is highest near full hip extension in the thrust.

cues.cue: Knees track over the toes, pushing slightly out.
cues.why: Keeps the hips in line and adds glute medius work.

breathing: Breathe in at the bottom, brace, breathe out as you lock out.

mistakes.name: Low back arches at the top
mistakes.looks: The ribs flare and the low back bends to lift the hips higher.
mistakes.fix: Tuck the chin and pelvis; stop when hips are straight.
mistakes.why: Range comes from the spine instead of the hips.

mistakes.name: Hips do not reach full extension
mistakes.looks: At the top the hips stay below the line from knees to shoulders.
mistakes.fix: Lighter load; pause and squeeze at the top.
mistakes.why: The part of the range with the most glute work is skipped.

mistakes.name: Knees cave in
mistakes.looks: Knees fall toward each other as the hips rise.
mistakes.fix: Push the knees out; add a band above the knees as a reminder.
mistakes.why: Shows weak hip control and twists the knee.

mistakes.name: Feet too far out
mistakes.looks: Shins slant forward and the knees are almost straight at the top; hamstrings cramp.
mistakes.fix: Walk the feet in until the shins are vertical at the top.
mistakes.why: The hamstrings take over from the glutes.

safety: Pad the bar; bruising over the hip bones is common.
Low back pain: keep the ribs down and avoid arching at the top.

variants.change: Loaded on the hips. A barbell thrust gave more glute activity than band or American (higher bench) thrust variations.
Shoulders on the floor: shorter range at the hip. One study found more glute activity in a barbell glute bridge than a barbell hip thrust.
One foot down: about the same peak glute force as a loaded split squat.
Band above the knees: push out against it; more glute medius.
Hold the bridge and lift one foot at a time; trunk must stay level.
Feet on a bench: bigger range, more hamstrings.
One foot ahead of the other: more load on the back foot.
Short range near the top only, constant tension.
Small fast reps near the top.
Hold the top position for time.

subtypes.name: Single-leg bridge or thrust
subtypes.change: One foot planted; the other knee is held up (or the leg straight in line).

subtypes.name: Frog pump / frog hip thrust
subtypes.change: Soles together, knees wide; short range near the top.

subtypes.name: Kneeling hip thrust
subtypes.match: kneeling hip thrust|on knees|kneeling pulse|kneeling hold to stand
subtypes.change: Kneeling, band or cable from behind at the hips: sit back toward the heels, then drive the hips forward to a tall kneel.

subtypes.name: Straight-leg / hamstring bridge
subtypes.match: hamstring bridge|straight leg glute bridge|straight leg hip bridge|heel glute bridge
subtypes.change: Heels farther out, knees only a little bent: hamstrings do more of the work.

subtypes.name: Glute bridge (floor)
subtypes.match: bridge|hip raise|hip lift|low back off floor|glute march
subtypes.change: Shoulders stay on the floor; hips lift from the floor to the line from shoulders to knees.

motion.basis: Barbell hip thrust as default. brazil2021 measured joint angles (hip demand highest, hip moment falls toward the top) but numbers were not available here; angles are estimates from the setup geometry: torso horizontal (trunk -90) at the top, knee near 90 with vertical shins. EMG findings from contreras2015, contreras2016, kennedy2024, andersen2018 and neto2020.
